name: zoom
description: Reads Zoom users, meetings, webinars, bounded module-specific data, SCIM2 groups/users, Virtual Agent knowledge-base/report data, Auto Dialer call history/reports/call lists/prospects, Tasks assignee/collaborator/comment/import/item data, and Workforce Management filter/forecast/import/organizational-group/report/schedule/user data through the Zoom REST API; includes sensitive Cobrowse SDK, SCIM2, Virtual Agent, Auto Dialer, Tasks, and Workforce Management reads, approval-gated Chatbot, SCIM2, Virtual Agent, Auto Dialer, Tasks, Workforce Management, clinical-note, and Quality Management actions, and a redacted Customer Managed Keys Hybrid archival key action.

risk.read: external Zoom API read of user, meeting, webinar, Quality of Service, AI Companion, My Notes, healthcare clinical-note, Quality Management, Cobrowse SDK session, SCIM2 user/group, Virtual Agent knowledge-base/report, Auto Dialer call-history/report/call-list/prospect, Tasks assignee/collaborator/comment/import/item, and Workforce Management filter/forecast/import/organizational-group/report/schedule/user data
risk.write: typed Zoom Chatbot message, Link Unfurls, SCIM2 group/user, Virtual Agent article/sync, Auto Dialer call-list/prospect, Tasks assignee/collaborator/comment/file/import/item, Workforce Management status/CSV/organizational-group actions, healthcare clinical-note, and Quality Management actions, plus Customer Managed Keys Hybrid archival key decryption with redacted output
risk.approval: mutating commands require plan, preview, explicit approval, and execute; Chatbot, SCIM2, Virtual Agent article, Auto Dialer call-list/prospect, Tasks assignee/collaborator/comment/item deletion, and Workforce Management historical-status/organizational-group deletion plus Customer Managed Keys Hybrid archival key decryption additionally require typed confirmation; read-only commands require none
